name: Skip Ledger
distinctFrom: Gap Orchard assumes every question is required and optimizes follow-up budgets. Skip Ledger handles acyclic conditional gates, unresolved gate states and off-path answers, without capacity planning. Form Pruner handles semantic redundancy; Branch Atlas handles help-menu navigation. Neither audits conditional questionnaire completeness.
aiTask: real MiniLM question-label retrieval followed by mandatory human review
workflow: informal binary answer records + explicit gate DAG to reviewed path-aware verification checklist and complete artifacts
legacyNameCollisionResolved: Initial Gate Garden name was shared with an original-gallery game; renamed before final publication and source commit.
